dedupe_keys.name: sydney road traffic incidents clearance durations and zonal context 2017 2022

description: This dataset covers 85,611 road-traffic incidents in the Sydney Greater Metropolitan Area from January 2017 through July 2022. IIT Delhi and TU Delft researchers compiled crashes, vehicle breakdowns and other incidents with locations, start and end times, affected traffic and response information. The deposit combines raw and curated incident records with SA2-area road, public-transport, land-use and socioeconomic variables. Mendeley version 5 supplies CSV and XLSX tables, Shapefile archives and an API retrieval script free under CC BY 4.0. Running the retrieval script requires a separate Open Data Hub API key; the deposited historical files are public. Underreporting and differences between incident clearance duration and injury severity are limitations. Modellers could calibrate disruption durations or emergency-response and traffic-recovery simulations. model-sumo is a related traffic simulator and data-openstreetmap supplies a related network source. No incident records were downloaded, and neither API collection nor traffic simulation was executed.
name: Sydney road-traffic incidents, clearance durations and zonal context, 2017–2022
